args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter: Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue covers "Freight pricing this quarter," linking to a blog article and offering subscribers full charts via a companion piece (accessed with a work email).
- Article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
